label: Past-tense narrative prose
explanation: Fires across the tokens of past-tense narrative clauses (fiction, personal stories, dialogue), most reliably on verbs and complements following negations ("didn't know"), "to", "was", and "by". It fires strongest — as multi-token runs at 3x typical activation — on the opening tokens of sequences that begin mid-narrative with a past-tense predicate ("went much faster", "grew up in one"), and stays nearly silent in technical, scientific, medical, and code text, where only weak diffuse spillover on common tokens remains.
